dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the wide mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, forming a smooth parabolic curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, soft-gradient transitions between the light grey base and the localized darker mottled patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Two distinct circular pale spots on the posterior-lateral regions of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, longitudinal linear marks visible along the central dorsal axis, consistent with superficial epidermal scratches.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark oval aperture located at the anterior apex, representing the blowhole.
